meta.title: Voyager — Financial Data API Runtime Architecture

cards.title: Primary read path
items: Client → FastAPI → services → MongoDB → computed metrics JSON
GET /financial-metrics merges income, balance and cash-flow rows, then adds live price/technicals when Yahoo is reachable
price_data = 'unavailable' degrades gracefully instead of failing the request

cards.title: Async pull path
items: POST /pull (data:write scope) returns 202 + job_id; work runs as in-process asyncio tasks
MAX_CONCURRENT_PULLS=2, one active pull per key; per-job timeout and stale-job reaper free orphaned slots
Scrapers write parsed XBRL into MongoDB, which the read path then serves

cards.title: External dependencies
items: NSE / SEC EDGAR: XBRL filings (SEC needs SEC_IDENTITY, throttled to 10 req/s)
Yahoo Finance: quotes, 52-week range, SMA/EMA, RSI, Bollinger, ATR
MongoDB Atlas in production; local Mongo via docker-compose for development

cards.title: Trust boundaries
items: Service keys: only SHA-256 hash + 12-char prefix stored; raw key shown once at creation
Scopes: data:read for reads, data:write for pulls; fixed-window rpm cap in Mongo
/admin/keys guarded by VOYAGER_ADMIN_KEY; health/metrics endpoints intentionally public
Admin panel is operator-local and assumes network trust — it is not exposed by Render

cards.title: Observability & ops
items: Prometheus /metrics via middleware; /readyz probes the DB
Sentry error reporting when SENTRY_DSN is set
Render serves reads; pulls run locally against the same Atlas cluster (read-replica pattern)
